timeline.title: Scattered memories
timeline.visual: Photos scattered across phone, PC folder, cloud drive, and external archive placeholders.
timeline.voiceover: Our memories are everywhere — on phones, laptops, cloud drives, and old family computers.

timeline.title: The problem
timeline.visual: Family members in different places asking for photos; duplicated albums; old photo frame.
timeline.voiceover: But sharing them as real family stories is still difficult. Photos get lost, duplicated, or buried in endless galleries.
timeline.onscreen_text: Sharing is easy. Curating memories is hard.

timeline.title: Introducing Memory Circle
timeline.visual: Logo placeholder appears; family/community nodes connect around a shared album.
timeline.voiceover: Memory Circle creates a private shared space where families and communities build living memory albums together.

timeline.title: Keep photos where they are
timeline.visual: Source picker: Phone, PC, Google Drive, iCloud, OneDrive. Photos flow into album as references and display copies.
timeline.voiceover: Your photos can stay where you already keep them — on your device, PC, Google Drive, iCloud, OneDrive, or external archive.
timeline.onscreen_text: No forced migration. Connect what you already have.

timeline.title: Contribute memories
timeline.visual: User selects photo, adds caption, adds story, submits for approval.
timeline.voiceover: Members add photos, captions, dates, events, and stories from any device.

timeline.title: Approve and curate
timeline.visual: Approver screen with Approve, Edit & Approve, Request Changes, Reject.
timeline.voiceover: Trusted members approve, edit, and curate what becomes part of the official album.

timeline.title: Flip album display
timeline.visual: Desktop two-page spread, tap-to-flip, mobile swipe version, fullscreen display mode.
timeline.voiceover: Approved memories appear in a beautiful tap-to-flip album — on PCs, phones, tablets, and living-room screens.
timeline.onscreen_text: A classic album, rebuilt for connected families.

timeline.title: Archive confidence
timeline.visual: Album health screen: display copies available offline, full archive device planned, cloud backup optional.
timeline.voiceover: Memory Circle keeps the album organized, cached, and ready for future archive protection.

timeline.title: Closing
timeline.visual: Album flips slowly; members connected around it; logo and tagline.
timeline.voiceover: Memory Circle: everyone contributes, trusted people curate, and the album lives everywhere.
timeline.onscreen_text:
Memory Circle
Everyone contributes. Trusted people curate. The album lives everywhere.
